<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-2502-50-10" status="unreviewed">dang po na byas pa'i rang ldog la tshul 3 gyi rtags kyi tha snyad sgrub pa na tshul 3 la shes byas khyab pi ma khyab | dang po ltar na mi mthun phyogs
               <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="57a4"/>kyis khyab pas mthun phyogs la mi 'jug pas 'gal bar 'gyur ba las yang dag du nges la 2 pa ltar na yang tshul 3 shes bya ma yin par thal lo zhe na | 
               
               'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang nag</rs></note> na re tshul 3 la shes bya mi mthun phyogs yin pas khyab kyang 'gal bar mi 'gyur te mthun phyogs rtsol byung la rjes 'gro yod pa'i phyir zhes zer ba ni ma yin te | tshul 3 mi mthun phyogs shes
               <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="57a5"/>bya kho na la yod na mthun phyogs la rjes 'gro yod pa nyams pa <expan>yin no</expan> || </seg></TEI>
